scope: home SSR scheduling and post-pricing browser payload only

separation.applicationCheckout: exact committed home-only SHA, directly based on appBaseSha
separation.operatorCheckout: separate exact reviewed operator commit; modern release scripts must not be copied into the app source closure
separation.calculationIdentity: source hash is a source proof; serving namespace must match freshly observed incumbent and immutable ready data

orderedStages.name: source-and-build
required: New controller and marker pins, without editing or reusing old one-time authorization
Run verify-home-ui-source.mjs against exact clean app checkout and reviewed full diff
Locked dependency installation and exact-source security checks without production credentials
Web and engine TypeScript; home-card-payload, home-initial-catalog and home-rendering tests
Preserve all applicable current release regressions; do not reclassify failures as success
Restore only freshly verified immutable incumbent encyclopedia binding/index, using read-only allowlisted object access
Docker revision label equals exact app SHA; record immutable image ID
Load the exact image without app start or ingress change

orderedStages.name: private-candidate
required: No overlapping release; exact current container, image, environment, process and Nginx preimage
Acquire existing /run/lock/avtocena-runtime-change.lock, never a second independent lease
Create only the exact new loopback candidate; preserve current serving calculation namespace and active China runtime mode
Exact release/calculation health; complete home SSR and API, prices, totals, selected city and evidence semantics
Protected China generation, lists/details and neighbouring markets remain unchanged
Current complete overview readiness for current UTC+7 day and next two days, without provider intake or manifest changes
Existing frozen server timings including warm and expired-cache phases; do not remove routes or raise thresholds

orderedStages.name: guarded-activation
required: Extend tests/release-speed-guard-contract.test.mjs to inventory the new controller before enabling it
Verify both frozen baseline digests before host access and again at the applicable runtime gate
Use the current regcloud-deploy-with-browser.sh nonce/verdict contract; no direct unguarded deploy entrypoint
Do not run generic host activation unchanged against different current container roles; preserve exact identity and CAS protections in the reviewed operator
Hold the same runtime lease across final identity checks, rollback backup, exact allowed Nginx change and acceptance
Check config preimage again immediately before change; nginx test and reload only on the approved deterministic postimage
Exact release health through private, gateway and public paths; full visible results and unchanged protected data
Post-switch server speed enforcement and resource measurements
Mobile and desktop browser functional, price, city, filter, request-count and speed checks
Browser verdict must match app SHA and one-use nonce; missing, stale, timeout or failed result keeps rollback mandatory
Disarm rollback only after every required gate succeeds; retain previous image, environment and Nginx configuration

orderedStages.name: rollback
required: On any failed acceptance restore only the exact captured predecessor
Never overwrite a foreign Nginx postimage or changed runtime identity
Restore captured restart policy and ingress, then verify predecessor health and protected data
Keep data pointers and provider cursors unchanged throughout
